::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Samsung's semiconductor R&D in Bengaluru works on Exynos mobile SoCs and modem design. Part of Samsung's broader India R&D footprint which is its largest outside South Korea.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Exynos mobile application processors, 5G modem IPs, display driver ICs, and custom neural processing units for on-device AI.
